title: Juicy Australian Potato Buns Bao
description: A comforting Australian dish featuring potato buns, inspired by Korean ttukbaegi earthenware cooking with a dash of Aussie flair.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the beef and a pinch of salt.
Add the ground pepper and mix well.
Form the beef mixture into small balls, about 1 inch in diameter.
Place the potato buns in the ttukbaegi earthenware, overlapping them slightly.
Place a beef ball in the center of each bun.
Cover the ttukbaegi earthenware with a lid and cook for 20 minutes.
After 20 minutes, remove the lid and cook for an additional 10 minutes, or until the potato buns are golden brown and the beef is cooked through.
Serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
Garnish with fresh parsley or thyme, if desired.
